about_the_game:
Do you lack motivation for learning grammatical genders,
or would you like to try learning new words just for fun?

What's My Gender gives you a tool for daily learning.

Use 5-7 minutes of your day to efficiently memorize words and return again next day for rewards. Gadgets will help you learn more difficult words and the game brings you reward images for correct answers, all the while being tormented by mean taunts from old people.
If you do not fancy the images, you can create and easily load your own reward image packs.
Also contains secrets for the curious minds.

The game has four default languages for learning: German, Italian, French, Spanish.
You may also create your own additional language packs.



  • 18 reward poses + 8 Unlockable with progress
  • 3 Unlockable style variations with progress
  • 38 Unlockable Animated Icons
  • 90 Unlockable Portfolio photos (days in a row unlock)
  • Unlockable Pro Mode for challenging play, unlocked from a challenge
  • Additional difficult extra challenges (days in a row unlock)
  • Image slice reducing camera items unlocked from challenges
  • 9 Blue gadgets and 3 passive pink gadgets
  • Additional Special Coins
  • Unlockable mini-content
  • Hidden Bonus Content that includes game completion
  • Your own images and word pack support

Gadgets can be purchased with blue and pink balls that you gain as rewards. The available gadgets change daily in the shop.

Submerge yourself into the dreamy world of What's My Gender and make your retirement days useful by learning a language or two before you kick the bucket.

content_descriptors.notes:
The game contains nudity and sexual content in a mild way. Contrary to what the name of the game might imply, it does not paint any transgender theme other than possibly imaginary. The gender does really just refer to language genders. Nudity is displayed in a slightly erotic fashion, such as breasts, but when exaggerated, it is displayed more in sense of humor rather than Eroticism.

Alcohol usage is tied to a single character, and the usage is more ridiculed than embraced. Empty bottles are used to return for money. Gambling slot machines are present  in some environments. Both cases aim to paint the negative aspects of retirement and old age, in a humorous way, rather than celebrate it.
